reference.load_interpolation: piecewise linear on every Newmark interval
reference.temporal_integrator: matrix exponential of augmented [q, qdot, p, pdot] state
reference.independence: does not call or reproduce the Newmark recurrence

model.geometry: NAFEMS 13H square plate 10 m x 10 m x 0.05 m

limitations: The exact oracle shares the assembled MITC4 mass and stiffness, so it isolates temporal error only.
The Code_Aster same-mesh comparison is stored as a separate external correlation.
Small-displacement linear dynamics and mass-proportional damping only.
